# Evidence & API Requirements Quality Checklist: Agente de Pesquisa em Artigos Científicos (PDF)

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, completeness, and measurability of evidence-grounding and API/error-handling requirements before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are evidence-traceability requirements defined for every result field (file, page, excerpt, relevance, citation)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are requirements defined for distinguishing facts-in-articles from AI interpretation in every response? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are requirements defined for the "no sufficient evidence" response, including partial matches? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the `/ask` request and response schema fully specified? [Completeness, contracts/query-api.md]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for every LLM failure mode (unavailable, invalid key, rate limit, incomplete response)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Is `article_id` derivation unambiguously specified (metadata vs filename fallback)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is "page determinable vs not determinable" defined with objective criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "relevance" defined measurably, beyond the generic phrase "semantic similarity"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are the distinct per-failure LLM messages specified in enough detail to implement each type? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "low confidence" (partial match) defined objectively rather than left ambiguous? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 - Are evidence-grounding requirements consistent between constitution Principle I and spec FR-004/FR-005? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the result schema consistent across spec FR-003, data-model "Resultado", and contracts/query-api.md? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are provider-independence requirements consistent across FR-006, FR-007, and SC-005? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 - Is SC-002 ("100% traceable") measurable and verifiable without implementation details? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is SC-005 ("≥2 providers") quantified and testable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are all acceptance scenarios (Given/When/Then) complete and testable for US1–US3? [Acceptance Criteria]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 - Are primary and alternate flows defined for asking a question? [Coverage, Spec US1]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are exception flows defined for LLM API failures within the user journey? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are recovery flows defined (retry after invalid key, re-run after rate limit)? [Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 - Are requirements defined for scanned/non-extractable PDFs? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are requirements defined for indeterminate page numbers? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for an empty directory or directory with no PDFs? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for subdirectory traversal and access restriction to the authorized directory? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK024 - Are performance expectations quantified (e.g., single LLM round-trip, response time)? [NFR]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are security/privacy requirements defined for API-key handling (not exposed in the UI)? [Gap, NFR]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK026 - Is the "~35 PDFs" scale assumption documented and validated? [Assumption]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are external LLM-provider dependencies and their failure modes documented? [Dependency, Spec §FR-012]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK028 - Is the "relevance" interpretation (semantic vs literal) resolved without conflict between spec and constitution? [Ambiguity]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
